name: mwv
description: Music Waves Visualizer is a web page to create audio waveforms and movie by loading image and music.
author: komura-c

scripts.build:html: node scripts/copy-ffmpeg-core.cjs && mv pages/api .api.bak 2>/dev/null; BUILD_HTML=1 npx next build && npx next export -o out && mv .api.bak pages/api 2>/dev/null; rm -rf visualizer && mkdir -p visualizer && cp -r out/* visualizer && cp htaccess-for-export visualizer/.htaccess && cp html-deploy-README.txt visualizer/README.txt
